desktop.ask_hint: Choose whether to stay in the tray or exit each time.
desktop.tray_hint: Hide the window and keep chats and QQ/WeChat connected.
desktop.exit_hint: Stop the core and bundled extensions, including active tasks.
desktop.autostart_hint: Start this copy when you sign in and keep it in the tray. Off by default.
desktop.saved_immediately: These options save immediately. No core restart is needed.
import.error.response_empty: The model returned no final mapping. An automatic retry was attempted. Check JSON output support or choose another model and analyze again.
import.error.response_incomplete: The model reached its output limit before completing the mapping. Analyze again or choose a model with a larger output budget.
import.error.response_json: The model did not return a valid JSON mapping. Analyze again or choose a model that supports JSON output.
import.error.service_json: The model service returned an incompatible response. Check the API URL, protocol and model configuration.
import.error.response_refused: The model refused to create a mapping. Check the service restrictions or try another model.
import.error.encoding: This file is not readable UTF-8 text. Export it as UTF-8 and try again.
import.error.json_extra: additional content follows the complete JSON document
import.error.json_invalid: the JSON is incomplete or contains invalid characters
import.warning.source_json: Source line {line}, column {column}: {reason}. The complete original text was analyzed; check message counts and identities before importing.
import.error.analysis_failed: Automatic format analysis did not finish: {reason}
setup.core_waiting_hint: Starting and checking the core. This status updates automatically.
updates.github_unavailable: Cannot connect to GitHub: {reason}. Check your connection and try again.
import.identity_samples: Show sample messages for these accounts
import.identities_missing: Select accounts for both people in these files: {files}
import.small_index_hint: Smaller tables do not need an acceleration index yet. Their imported content is still searchable.
import.core_restarting: Records imported. Restarting the core to apply your identities…
import.core_waiting: The core is starting. You can continue when it is ready…
import.core_ready: Import complete. The core is ready to continue.
import.core_restart_failed: Your records were imported, but the core is not ready yet.
import.core_timeout: The core is taking longer to start. Check its log and retry.
concurrency.invalid: Concurrency must be an integer between 1 and 64.
concurrency.embedding: Controls embedding requests during record imports and memory indexing. Increase it within your service quota if imports are slow.
concurrency.small: State, summaries, review and other features using this small model share this limit. Disabled features stay disabled.
concurrency.main: Format detection, offline analysis and chat tasks using this main model share this limit.
concurrency.rerank: Limits simultaneous memory-reranking requests. Changing it does not enable reranking.
concurrency.vision: Limits simultaneous image requests. Image recognition using the main model follows the main-model limit.
concurrency.tradeoff: Range: 1–64. Higher concurrency can reduce queues for batch tasks, but exceeding your service quota can cause rate limits or timeouts. It does not speed up one model response.
concurrency.shared: The same API base URL and model share request slots. If multiple enabled profiles use the same service and model, the lower limit applies.
concurrency.apply: Save, then restart and apply the core settings before importing. Running tasks keep their current settings.
analysis.prompt_notice: Generating a report and using it are separate choices. These switches default to off. Save and apply the core configuration to take effect. Enabling them does not run analysis or enable experimental profiles.
analysis.use_personality: Use personality and relationship observations in chat
analysis.use_personality_hint: Use the generated personality context to inform wording and interaction. Current conversation and real records take priority over historical inferences.
analysis.use_life: Use routines and habits in life decisions
analysis.use_life_hint: Allow the original core to use an existing life analysis in its life decisions. This switch does not itself enable proactive messages or generate a schedule.
analysis.applying_preferences: Preferences saved. Waiting for the core to become ready.
analysis.no_findings: This report contains no findings. Review the block diagnostics or analyze again without cached results.
analysis.no_section_findings: No observations are available in this section.
analysis.initiative: Conversations initiated by the other person
analysis.empty_explanation: The task finished, but its reports are empty. Task completion does not mean usable analysis. Review the block errors below.
analysis.partial_explanation: The reports are partial: some reports are empty or blocks were skipped. Review what is missing before using them.
analysis.available_explanation: Findings are available. Review their textual evidence; model observations are not established facts.
analysis.cache_notice: The original core may cache empty blocks after output parsing fails. Analyzing without cache calls your configured main model again and may incur charges.
analysis.no_recorded_error: No block errors were recorded in this manifest. Older cached results may have been reused, or evidence may be insufficient. Run without cache to obtain fresh diagnostics.
stickers.invalid: Invalid sticker details. Check the description, owner and tags.
stickers.invalid_name: Use a name of 1–32 letters, numbers, Chinese characters, underscores or hyphens.
stickers.image_failed: The sticker image could not be loaded.
stickers.size_limit: Each sticker must be no larger than 2 MB.
stickers.title: Stickers for you and your companion
stickers.notice: Choose who can use each sticker, or share it. The original core selects companion stickers using their descriptions. Sticker tokens in chat are displayed as images.
stickers.file_hint: PNG, JPG, GIF and WebP, up to 2 MB each. Animated images are preserved.
stickers.name: Name
stickers.description_hint: Describe its meaning and suitable situations to help your companion choose it.
stickers.empty: No stickers here yet. Choose an image to add one.
stickers.delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? Historical messages keep its token, but will no longer display the image.
stickers.picker_empty: No stickers are available for you. Add some under Advanced and select “For me” or “For both”.
media.title: Import images from chat history
media.description: Add images referenced in your chat exports to memory.
media.notice: Import the text records and confirm identities first, then choose a folder containing the original exports and their images. This calls your configured vision and embedding services. The core pauses during import and resumes afterward, including after cancellation.
media.vision_required: Enable a dedicated image import model or conversation vision, then save and apply the configuration.
media.restart_required: Restart the core to apply the current service configuration first.
media.wait_for_task: Historical images are being imported. Wait for completion or cancel before changing the core.
media.done: Image import finished. Review the counts.
media.cancelled: Image import cancelled. Images already indexed are retained.
media.interrupted: The previous import was interrupted when the app exited. Start again; the original core skips existing images.
media.worker_failed: The image importer returned no valid report. See history-images.log.
media.restart_error: The image task ended, but restoring the core failed: {reason}
media.no_refs: No importable image references were found. The folder needs a chat export supported by the original core and its referenced images. Images alone cannot be linked automatically.
media.missing_notice: Some images are missing or exceed limits. Check that the original images are included with the export, then import again.
updates.core_current: The Afterglow core matches the current repository version.
updates.invalid_source: The Afterglow source archive is invalid. The installed core was not replaced.
updates.source_changed: The repository changed during download or its source versions do not match. Check for updates again.
updates.dependencies_changed: This core version changes Python or dependency requirements, so the current portable runtime cannot be reused directly. The installed core is retained. Update the desktop runtime bundle or import a new offline core package.
updates.repository_checked: Checked the Afterglow and desktop repository versions.
updates.repository_check_failed: Some repositories could not be reached directly. Their latest versions could not be confirmed. Try again later.
updates.core_source_hint: Core updates download source directly from the original Afterglow repository. Settings and memories stay in the instance data folder.
advanced.description: Chat analysis, historical image memories and stickers for both participants.
debug.settings_description: Inspect core activity and model calls. Leave this off for everyday use.
debug.enabled_hint: Synchronizes DEBUG_ENDPOINTS_ENABLED in this instance’s configuration. Restart the core to apply. Access stays local and authenticated.
debug.full_payloads: Record full model requests and responses
debug.full_payloads_hint: Off by default. Includes prompts and conversation text and uses more memory. Enable only when needed; disabling debug mode also disables this.
debug.restart_hint: Restart the core after saving to enable or disable endpoints. Wait for import or analysis tasks to finish before applying.
debug.next_start_hint: Saved preferences take effect the next time the core starts.
debug.applying: Debug settings saved. The core is getting ready again.
debug.saved: Debug settings saved. Restart the core to apply.
debug.saved_next_start: Debug settings saved for the next core start.
debug.title: Inside Afterglow
debug.current_conversation: Current instance · Retrieval and proactive generation use this conversation
debug.instance_scope: Current instance · Open from a chat to use that conversation’s context
debug.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Try again.
debug.database_hint: Expand operation statistics, recent queries and slow queries. Fields come from the running core.
debug.reset_hint: Resets recorded call metrics and model traces. Conversations and memory are kept.
debug.no_snapshot: No diagnostics loaded. Select Refresh to try again.
debug.payloads_recording: Full request and response recording is enabled. Expand a call to inspect its content. Only calls recorded while enabled contain full bodies.
debug.payloads_not_recorded: Full body recording is off. Stages, timing, status and errors are shown. Enable body recording separately in Settings.
debug.no_calls: No model calls yet. Refresh after a chat or task.
debug.retrieval_hint: Runs the core’s retrieval pipeline and shows fused and per-source hits. Uses configured model services and may consume API quota. It does not send a chat message.
debug.proactive_hint: Manually generates a proactive message through the core and may incur model costs. The result is displayed here and is not sent to QQ or WeChat contacts. The core writes generated content to this conversation’s memory and context.
debug.preview_silenced: The core chose to stay silent.
debug.preview_empty: The core returned no message. Inspect the details.
debug.config_hint: Reads the core’s configuration snapshot. Keys are represented by set/unset flags, without their values.
debug.privacy: Diagnostics may contain conversation text and personal information. Review before sharing. The panel is cleared when switching instances or disabling debug mode.
debug.disabled: Enable debug mode in Settings first.
debug.apply_required: Debug endpoints are not active. Save and restart the core.
debug.invalid_preferences: Debug settings must use boolean values.
debug.invalid_search: Enter 1–4000 characters. Top K must be an integer from 1 to 50.
debug.conversation_required: Open the debug panel from an existing conversation to generate a proactive message.
debug.invalid_proactive: Proactive generation parameters are invalid or too long.
analysis.personality_required: Generate a report with personality observations and its prompt context before enabling this option. Empty reports cannot be used. If an enabled option has lost its artifacts, turn it off first.
analysis.life_required: Generate a life profile containing their routines or habits before enabling this option. A timeline or an empty report is not sufficient. If the artifacts are missing, turn this option off first.
services.image_import_vision_description: Used only for historical image import. Set its API URL, model, key, protocol and concurrency independently. Conversation images keep their existing settings.
services.image_import_vision_hint: Optional. When off, imports use your existing vision settings. When on, historical images use a separate model, even with conversation vision disabled.
services.image_import_vision_cost: Images are sent to this model service. Bulk import can take time and incur model charges.
analysis.model_diagnostics_hint: Metadata for the last 12 abnormal responses in this task. No chat text or reasoning text is recorded. When reasoning shares the output limit, no budget may remain for the final JSON.
analysis.response_empty: The model service returned a successful status with an empty final answer.
analysis.response_reasoning: The model returned reasoning but no final answer for analysis.
analysis.response_limit: The output limit was reached before the final JSON completed. Check the model reasoning settings and output budget.
analysis.response_incomplete: The model service marked this response as incomplete; it was not used as valid analysis.
analysis.response_refused: The model refused the request or content filtering stopped generation.
analysis.response_http: The model service rejected or failed to process the request. Check the HTTP status below.
analysis.response_unavailable: The model service could not be reached or its response timed out.
analysis.response_invalid: The service response does not match the selected API protocol. Check Chat Completions / Responses.
analysis.response_metadata: Protocol {protocol} · Finish {finish} · Output limit {budget} · Output used {output} · Reasoning used {reasoning}
